idea-plugin.name: JavaCard Express
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the errors of the JavaCard Express javac check in the editor while you type: code outside the Java Card language subset (long, String, lambdas, enums, ...) and API the target Java Card platform does not have are marked at their source lines, with the same message the build gives.

The plugin has no rules of its own. In a module whose compilation runs the check (the JavaCard Express Maven plugin as a build extension, or the applet parent, puts it on the annotation processor path), it compiles the package of the open file in memory with the project's own check, in the version the build uses, and marks what the check reports.
